name: a doorway repeating into itself
description: A door, correct in every particular, occurring several times in the same place — each frame a little smaller, receding into itself, all of them slightly ajar.
looks: Opening it would open all of them, in order, quite slowly.
The handle is at four heights and each is the right one.
Behind it is this room, one iteration in, with somebody in it who moves when you move.
says: I go where you have already been. Sorry.
There is no last one. I have checked.
emotes: {it} swings a few degrees, and every copy of it swings a moment later, in order.
A draught comes out of {it} that has been through several rooms to get here.
{it} adds another frame to the sequence, quietly, while you are looking elsewhere.
asks: Which one were you going to use?
Did you come in through me? Think about it before you answer.
Shall I keep going, or is this enough?
